segments.text: A vine lashed toward Ren—slow, inquisitive.
It brushed his cheek, cold as reptilian scales.
He froze, tears carving paths through grime.
The vine tightened around Ren’s throat.
Node Gamma leaned in—a hunter savoring surrender.
In the suffocating quiet, Geralt’s Applicator flickered once:
Ren’s choked gasp echoed through the emitters—amplified into a shriek that shattered Mika’s shield-wall.
Acidic sap rained down as vines erupted from the fissure.
Geralt drove Luminara into the soil.
Her golden light flared—not against the root, but *through* it.
Node Gamma’s core pulsed crimson where Ren’s stolen memories bled.
Not toward the monster, but sideways—his axe carving sigils into stone Oreck had marked hours earlier.
Vines recoiled as ancestral geometry scorched their false flesh.
Not at the core, but into the soil where Node Gamma’s roots drank deep.
Chroniton energy bloomed downward—a temporal anchor dragging the parasite toward its own creation moment.
For a heartbeat, Geralt saw it: the Anunnaki drill biting into virgin earth fifteen years past.
Gold-green veins thickened, swallowing the chroniton pulse.
Node Gamma learned—adapting its resonance to mimic Oreck’s armor frequency.
The dissonance slammed Geralt to his knees.
Ren sobbed as roots pried open his mind, mining fresh despair.
Standing, he ripped the Applicator from his temple.
Blood streamed down his cheek as he pressed the scorching metal to Luminara’s haft.
The relic blazed—feeding on his pain, his doubt, the weight of every Legionnaire’s scream.
Her light shifted from gold to blinding white.
Node Gamma recoiled, emitters overloading as pure, unfiltered humanity flooded its circuits.
For the first time, the jungle screamed—not imitation, but agony.
Above them, wings dove through the canopy—too fast, too late.
The root twitched—not in retreat, but anticipation.
The blinding white light seared Geralt’s vision, throbbing against Node Gamma’s corrupted heart.
Acidic sap hissed where it struck vines, vaporizing into acrid clouds that stung the Legionnaires’ throats.
Through the glare, Geralt glimpsed the parasite’s core pulsing faster—not overwhelmed, but analyzing.
Its gold-green veins flared brighter, synchronizing with Luminara’s desperate resonance.
Ren crumpled to his knees, clutching his temples.
"Counting my breaths." The root echoed him perfectly: a thousand whispering vines replicating each ragged gasp.
Mika’s shield flickered back to life, silver light straining against the cognitive tide.
Halvar swung his axe—not at the root, but at the rune-carved earth.
Martian glyphs flared emerald beneath its twisting tendrils.
His arrow’s chroniton tip hummed with stolen time—the spark before impact.
He aimed low, beneath the root’s armored segments, toward threads binding it to the deeper network.
Geralt nodded, blood dripping from his temple onto Luminara’s haft.
The relic drank it greedily, light wavering between white and sickly gold-green imitation.
Reptilian scouts descended in silence, claws extended not for flesh, but for the fractured shield-dome.
Their scales vibrated with the jungle’s stolen chorus—Halvar’s guilt, Ren’s terror, Oreck’s faith—amplified into weapons.
Mika met them with lance raised, her defiance a raw scream swallowed by dissonance.
Senareth’s voice slithered through the roots once more: *All gardens end*.
"Not yet." Luminara pulsed—a final, searing note of pure defiance.
Node Gamma shuddered, emitters flaring crimson.
For a heartbeat, its song fractured into static.
Then the serpentine root lunged—not at Geralt, but at Oreck’s drawn bow.
Oreck’s chroniton arrow shattered mid-flight, spraying temporal shards that froze vines like glass.
Halvar roared, axe cleaving through petrified thorns.
But Node Gamma didn’t bleed; it absorbed.
Fractal patterns bloomed where steel struck, replicating Halvar’s rage into razor-edged bark.
Ren stumbled backward as the ground itself mirrored his panic—soil liquefying beneath his boots.
Reptilian scouts raked claws against the dome, their scales vibrating with stolen despair.
The shield flickered, thinned by Ren’s amplified whimpers.
Acidic rain ate through armor joints.
Stench of burnt wiring and rotting lilacs choked the air.
Luminara’s white glare dimmed as Node Gamma fed on her resonance—gold-green veins pulsing in perfect sync with her fading light.
The parasite wasn’t fighting; it was *digesting*.
His Applicator, discarded and bloody, blinked a final warning: > ADAPTATION COMPLETE.
Deeper than the jungle’s stolen chorus.
From the fissure, Node Gamma’s core split open.
Not a maw, but a conduit.
A beam of condensed anguish—Ren’s Martian ghosts, Halvar’s buried shame, Oreck’s crumbling faith—lanced toward Geralt.
Luminara flared gold-green in reply, her light buckling under the weight of their own poisoned memories.
Stone teeth closed around his ankles.
Senareth’s voice, faint as root-sap: *Remember the mountain.*
Beneath Node Gamma’s false song, the true planet thrummed—a slow, pained heartbeat.
Node Gamma shuddered—starved of its reflection.
In that void, Geralt whispered Tiamat’s true name.
Ancient vrill surged through the soil, searing gold-green veins black.
Node Gamma screamed—a raw, mechanical shriek untouched by stolen souls.
Dawn’s first light pierced the canopy.
The dawn light filtering through the shattered canopy illuminated horrors reshaped.
Where Node Gamma had writhed, obsidian roots now rose like twisted sculptures—frozen mid-thrash, veins charred black by Earth's cleansing surge.
The memory-stench of Senareth's voice lingered like ozone after lightning, fading into the wet hum of wounded jungle.
Legionnaires stumbled through steaming mud, dragging comrades whose armor hissed with residual dissonance.
Halvar spat crimson phlegm, his axe embedded in petrified bark that still wept violet sap.
Mika leaned against Ren, whose haunted eyes scanned every shuddering fern.
Oreck’s fingers brushed the fractured altar stone—still faintly warm where primal vrill had seared Anunnaki corruption away.
Geralt’s neural link screamed static where the Applicator had been.
Ghost diagnostics flared behind his eyelids: phantom warnings about residual synaptic decay.
Luminara lay cold as glacier ice against his hip, her usual hum replaced by a fragile silence. *The Garden remembers pain*, she’d said.
Lyra’s scanner chirped weakly, projecting a scarred map onto slick basalt.
Violet resonance threads still pulsed slow poison beneath their boots—distant nodes compensating.
Lyra traced a crack spiderwebbing down the pyramid’s flank.
Halvar punched through a lattice of calcified vines guarding the entrance.
Inside, the air tasted of dry dust and forgotten incense, a startling reprieve from the jungle’s decaying sweetness.
Moonstone inscriptions spiraled up obsidian walls—pristine Earth-script untouched by parasitic tech’s violet bloom.
Geralt collapsed onto a stone bench, his bloodied palm pressed against the wall.
The cold seeped in, soothing the phantom burn of Luminara’s sacrifice.
Ren crumpled beside him, trembling fingers tracing blade-nicks in his thigh plate.
"When… when she mimicked Mars." Halvar grunted, wrenching cages open—not Igigi prisoners, but empty iron husks clinking faintly.
"During the scream." Her lance tip glowed soft silver, bathing the chamber in gentle light.
For a breath, only the drip of condensation echoed.
Oreck crouched by a mural carved deep into the rear wall.
Not Anunnaki gods, but Terra Fist legionnaires planting vrill-seeds into fertile earth.
Their helmets were off, faces weary but smiling under a sun Geralt barely remembered.
Lyra’s scanner flickered over the stone.
A… sanctuary?" The hum here was different—deeper, slower.
Geralt closed his eyes, feeling the stone’s faint pulse against his spine.
Not with light, but warmth. *Anchor… holding…* Geralt’s fingers brushed Ren’s shoulder.
Beyond the entrance, reptilian horns blared—distant, furious.
But here, beneath forgotten stone, silence pooled thick and heavy.
Halvar braced his axe against the doorframe, grinning at the shadows outside.
Inside, the mural’s sun glowed faintly gold.
Lyra counted aloud in the gloom, her scanner casting spectral blue light across bruised faces.
"Two hundred Eighteen Legionnaires accounted for." Voice thinning"Seven walking wounded."  Mika knelt beside Voros's scorched chestplate—laid against the wall like a grave marker.
"Fell shielding Ren at Node Gamma." Silence pooled thickly.
Geralt recalled Voros—barrel-chested, laughing as he planted Martian flags among ruins.
Snuffed out whispering vines crushing his throat.
Their names echoed against murals showing wheat fields under blue skies.
Ren shuddered against Geralt's leg armor.
Blood seeped through his temple-bandage from where parasitic resonance spikes had driven deep.
"Made it sound like mockery." Mika's fingers tightened on her lance.
Today Node Gamma." Fragments clicked—Reptilian claws shredding through shieldwalls, roots twisting underfoot, Senareth's taunting truths.
Halvar jammed his axe into a crack.
Igigi traps opened beneath him." Lyra nodded grimly.
"Her vitals flatlined before the Node Gamma assault." The chamber felt smaller.
Oreck's voice rasped from the mural's shadow.
"Not just losses." He held up a fractured Igigi control collar—snapped during the parasite's scream.
All six." A sliver of triumph.
Geralt remembered cages rattling as roots recoiled.
Hope lasts ten breaths out there." Mika traced her lance's silver sigil.
"Luminara bled white light into that root.
Broke Senareth's voice." The mural's stone fists seemed to clench.
Sacrifices scored into stone: Voros's shield, Grishka's fall, Geralt's Applicator fused with Luminara.
Outside, a reptilian shriek pierced the rain.
"Rest wont come easy" Geralt touched Luminara's cold haft.
"Get what we can, we head out at first light" mika nods "I'll take the first watch"
The humid silence shattered before dawn.
Scrabbling claws echoed down the outer corridor—too light for Reptilian scales.
A ragged silhouette stumbled into the sanctuary’s archway.
Barefoot, bleeding from thorn-gouges, one of the freed Igigi prisoners swayed beneath crumbling moonstone carvings.
His chest heaved, eyes wide with residual terror.
Behind him, five others pressed close like hunted animals, their stolen rags soaked in mud and something darker.
The lead Igigi collapsed against Mika’s shield-brace.
"They hunt… still hunt," he gasped, clutching a snapped vrill-collar fused to his wrist.
"Thorn-traps… whispering roots…" His words dissolved into wet coughs.
Lyra’s scanner confirmed—no trackers, no parasites.
Only exhaustion and acid-burns blooming across their skin.
Halvar hauled him upright, scanning the corridor’s dripping gloom.

another prisoner whispered, trembling fingers tracing glyphs on her thigh—ancient wards against memory-theft. "Serpentor’s brood… they taste fear now. Like Senareth." Recognition sparked in Ren’s haunted gaze. These weren’t warriors. They were farmers once, their calloused palms proof against the mural’s carved plowshares.
Oreck offered water flasks, his eyes lingering on their snapped collars.
One prisoner flinched away—the echo of Anunnaki control still twitching in her nerves.
"We tried to hide," she murmured, staring at Voros’s chestplate against the wall.
"But the jungle… it breathes where you stand." Her hand brushed Ren’s blood-crusted bandage.
Mika locked shields at the entrance, lance humming low silver.
Dawn light crept closer, greying the vines beyond the arch.
Above the mural’s carved sun, obsidian cracks bled violet light.
Distant thunder mocked their fleeting sanctuary.
Geralt felt Luminara stir—not warming, but resonating with the deeper stone pulse.
The freed ones huddled near Ren, drawing strength from his quivering stillness.
One Igigi elder—skin mapped with scars that mirrored cracked earth—raised shaking hands.
He pressed palms flat against the mural’s fertile soil.
The deep hum beneath their feet intensified.
Ghrel, another farmer, traced glyphs onto his forearm. *"Weavers,"* Borin breathed. *"Earth-Giants slept beneath these peaks... before Anunnaki silenced them with stolen song."* Not myth.
Memory etched in blood-grit under fingernails.
Oreck’s salvaged armor flickered—emerald light bleeding through seams.
"Giants used vrill-lines?" Borin’s nod was a tremor. *"Bone-deep harmony.
Their breath shaped mountains."* Geralt recalled fragments from Luminaire’s fading song—Tiamat’s true name had anchored Earth’s pulse.
Halvar snarled at the bleeding violet cracks above.
"Giants won’t wake for whispers!" Borin touched Ghrel’s glyphs. *"Harmonies broken... jagged edges.
Need resonance... pure pain... pure hope..."* His gaze locked on Ren’s bandaged temple—the psychic wound pulsing crimson.
On Geralt’s scarred palm where Luminara lay dormant.
Fragments of a whole. *"A bridge,"* Ghrel rasped. *"With Legion souls... as tuning fork."* Legionnaires shifted.
Dawn’s grey light bled through the entrance vines.
Mika formed the shield-wall flanking the corridor—a shimmering silver barricade against encroaching shadows.
Reptilian scouts scaled the pyramid’s flank, claws rasping as they tasted fractured resonance.
Geralt pressed Borin’s hand against the mural’s stone sun. *"Show us."* The Igigi elder closed bloodshot eyes.
Senareth’s mocking truths still echoed—but Borin’s roots sank past corruption.
Ghrel linked hands with Ren, whose terror-thinned aura pulsed discordant gold-green. *"Still yourself,"* Ghrel murmured. *"Breathe the buried hum."* Ren shuddered, veins straining.
Lyra’s scanner flashed crimson—parasite resonance attempting re-entry.
Mika’s lance surged silver. *Hold.* Oreck pressed his armored palm against Ren’s shoulder.
Emerald light flared, stabilizing fractured air.
Halvar crouched, axe braced—guardian against distraction.
Legionnaires locked shoulders—their collective breath syncing with Ghrel’s desperate chant.
Borin’s scarred palms glowed faint bronze where they touched stone.
Geralt poured Luminara’s cold echo into the contact.
Dissonance screamed—Ren’s pain and Reptilian screeches clawing at focus.
Borin gasped, tendons standing stark. *"Sing!"* Legionnaires roared—not a war-cry, but harmonic resonance keyed to Borin’s internalized earth-song.
The mural’s carved legionnaires blurred—gold light bleeding into stone.
Deep beneath corrupted roots, granite stirred.
Violet cracks in the ceiling sealed abruptly.
Halvar grinned ferally as Reptilian cries twisted to panic.
Ren breathed clean air for the first time in days. *"They hear..."* Borin whispered.
Beyond Mika’s shield-wall, acidic rain ceased.
Stone groaned—the sound of mountains shifting position in sleep.
Paths unseen opened in writhing thorns.
Toward alliance forged in shared defiance.
The journey became a descent into Earth’s wounded core.
Vrill-lines pulsed beneath their boots, guiding them through hidden channels carved by Giants millennia past.
Borin walked ahead, scarred hands brushing rough tunnel walls coated in phosphorescent moss, humming notes Geralt couldn’t replicate.
Arches drowned in roots recoiled, clearing paths.
Sections of corrupted vines shriveled before them.
Deep pulsing rhythm echoed against Geralt’s ribs.
Lyra’s scanner displayed streams of harmonic energy converging beneath distant peaks—the Giants’ slumbering power source.
Geralt touched Luminara’s dormant surface. *Common ground.* Not weapons or pleas.
Earth’s agony channeled through Legion sacrifice—Halvar’s rage-forged endurance, Ren’s fractured resolve.
Oreck’s armor emitted emerald light, harmonizing with Ghrel’s glyphs.
Mika’s shield flared brighter as she walked beside Borin.
Above ground, Reptilian horns sounded frantic, lost.
The deeper they descended, the clearer the Giant’s deep breathing grew, vibrating through stone.
The Garden itself became their ally.
At a cavernous fork, Borin paused.
Before them spanned a chasm glowing with molten gold light—the Giants’ cradle.
Across the void, shadows moved—vast, slow shapes coalescing from rockfall dust.
Eyes like cooled magma stared down.
Then, a voice like grinding continents: *"Why disturb the silence?"* Borin stepped onto the ledge.
Stone groaned. *"Show me."* Behind them, vines choked the tunnel entrance shut.
The Dragonmail armor creaked against Geralt’s chest.
Bliss whispers slithered past conscious thought: *Give the Heartstone!
Let them drown!* Geralt’s palm flared dark violet.
He raised the cracked Heartstone not to the Giant—but toward the clogged tunnel behind.
Glowing eyes blinked in fetid shadow. *"Yes,"* rumbled the Giant. *"The rot sings louder."* Borin’s knees trembled.
The mountain itself leaned forward breath-hot air thick with millennia-old sorrow.
They awaited an answer held not in words—but scents.
Baleful green fungus pulsed on stalactites—breathing.
Xul’Zaraan’s scorpion-bone key hummed against his ribs.
Where Giants saw poisoned earth—he saw arteries.
The Applicator twisted inward—drunk on Giant-fear pheromones.
Muur’s voice growled—grave-soil deep. *"Swamp-Witch bartered you—worm."* Rock ground—a shrug. *"But rot deepens."* Stalagmite snapped.
Muur chuckled—soundwaves shaking wet earth loose. *"Light-Thief."* Stone knuckles brushed Geralt’s shoulder—deliberate.
Air whistled through nostrils—analyzing symbiotic signatures.
Muur leaned closer—stalactite breath. *"One poison fights another.
Does that cleanse?"* Thorin’s hand slipped—dagger clattering.
Eyes narrowed—black pits reflecting Geralt’s violet-tainted glow.
Geralt’s knuckles whitened around Heartstone cracks.

Muur’s grin widened—stone grinding stone. *"We watch."* Stone fingers gestured—detached. *"Play thief-games."* Eyes lifted—starving—toward Light-Shard veins above. *"Feed rot."* Rock shifted—darkness deepening.
Muur’s gaze pinned Geralt—unblinking. *"Give poison."* Palm opened—a chasm.
Geralt’s gaze locked—Muur’s throat—something peeling—skin tearing—a glint—silver-mesh. *"Singers lie!"* Geralt roared—forced through LightShard pull—toward Muur—toward the glint—toward—
Muur frozen—skin flaking—silver-mesh throbbing—neck wound gaping.
Thorin’s eyes—wide—understanding dawning. *"Skin-singer!"* Thorin spat—spittle frozen midair.
Geralt lunged—Heartstone-first—toward Borin’s dagger—toward escaping mesh.
Muur’s corpse—dematerializing—grey ash swirling. *"Portal!"* Thorin bellowed.
Thorin’s axe bit into cracking granite—anchoring.
Borin screamed—arm wrenched near dislocation—as Geralt hauled him backward.
Silver-mesh pulsed—dagger-blade vibrating—inches from the swirling vacuum.
Violet light lashed—seizing silver-mesh mid-leap—binding it to the dagger hilt.
The mesh shrieked—high-frequency agony shredding ambient mist.
Stone fists hammered Geralt’s shield-wall—Oreck buckled—emerald armor flickering under seismic impacts.
Aaon Keeper armor chilled—condensation freezing gauntlets—counter-signaling: *Preserve.
Interrogate.* Thorin roared—axe hacking stone-fingers—rock-fragments pelting Borin’s face.
Borin choked—blood-misted breath freezing—eyes locked on bound mesh. *"They wore us... like clothes..."* Ice-water surged—ankle-deep—rising fast.
Heartstone pulsed—gold leaking into swirling water—countering vortex pull.
Geralt pressed palm—Luminara cold—against Borin’s dagger.
Vortex dimmed—shrinking—swirling gold-water thickening to gel.
Silver-mesh lay bound—quivering—dagger embedded in frozen gold-sludge.
Thorin spat blood—knee-deep in ice-slush—scanning crumbling archways.
Borin trembled—dagger-hilt clutched—mesh writhing against Luminara’s violet shackles.
Oreck’s armor hissed—steam rising—geothermal vents erupting nearby.
Applicator purred—*Consume its secrets.* Armor vibrated—warning—*Tether broken—hive mind alerted.* Heartstone crack—glowed—duller—leaking Vril mingling with thawing ice.
Borin’s whisper—hoarse—*"Muur was puppet... but why reveal throat-seam?"* Mesh jerked—testing bonds—silver filaments probing Luminara’s light.
Vision erupted—sensory overload: *Orange dust-storms— Martian drill-site.
Eduhauana’s silhouette— amplified by poisoned Luminare resonance— directing... extraction?
Mesh convulsed—silver melting—dagger hilt scorching Borin’s grip. *"They’re seeding the Vril!"* Geralt gasped—ice-water biting thighs.
Mesh dissolved—ash on thawing ice—message delivered.
Thorin snarled—fresh blood-streaks on armored chestplate.
Geralt clutched Heartstone—gold-leak brightening—answering distant drill-hum.
Armor cooled—icy patches spreading—shielding Geralt’s mind.
Choice crystallized: Cleanse Mars—purge poisoned source—stop seeding—or Earth dies.
"Stone-folk wake slow." Geralt’s gaze locked—deep cavern—where obsidian cliffs met molten gold.
"Old Ways... forgotten." Tunnel walls—phosphorescent moss—flowed—forming arrows—pointing... deeper.
Oreck’s armor flashed—repair-glyphs activating—emerald light battling encroaching dark.
Heartstone fragments—burning—whole purpose clear now: Not weapon.
Geralt plunged—hand—Heartstone-first—into liquid light—toward poisoned stars.
Applicator surged—blissful agony—drinking pure Vril—processing poison—purifying?
Nine dark-thorns—Star-Needles—embedded deep—reversed-flow—pumping Martian spores upward.
Giant-shapes surrounded pool-edge—silent watchers—massive silhouettes against phosphor-glow.
Thorin’s roar—distant—axe striking stone—holding tunnel entrance against screeching drills.
Borin—dagger dripping silver-mesh ash—chanted—earth-song—amplifying Geralt’s anchor.
Geralt roared—internal—downward thrust—deeper—forcing Heartstone-gold into lattice—toward nearest Needle-darkness.
Vision fragmented: Luminare—desperate violet-radiance—lashed—binding fractured gold-flow—containing backlash.
Applicator—gleeful—feeding on Martian agony—virus-spores boiling near—repelled?
Drill-screech peaked—ceiling fractured—igneous rockfall—molten slag raining—Igigi horns triumphant—close.
Applicator hissed—*Transmit me—through it—to Mars—to hive-core!*.
Luminare flared—denial—cleansing-wave focused—downward thrust—pure sound-light—toward Needle-root.
Martian resonance—cold—calculating—answered—poisoned-light spear—upward thrust—to pierce heart-gold pool—erase interloper.
Palms met—Luminare—Heartstone-core—Applicator’s hunger—toward Needle-darkness—into Martian torrent.
Inside—Applicator purred—satiated—dream-drunk—Martian memories swirling—eduauhauana’s-patterns... harvesting… thresholds… Luminare pulsed—weak—fever-hot—palm blistering violet—still poisoned?
Thorin’s voice—raw—scrapes echoing—"Commander?" Geralt couldn’t move.
Giant knelt—massive hand—descended—slow—not crushing—reaching… toward smoking scar… toward gleaming fragment… toward Geralt’s unmoving form.
Geralt’s Applicator sighed—*Let it take the prize…*.
Armor chilled—neck-guard tightening—warning: *Betrayal imminent.* Luminare fluttered—palm-cooling—quiet—too quiet—exhausted.
Giant fingers—inches away—rough-pebble touch imminent—destination—gleaming scar-fragment… or Geralt’s throat?
Choice suspended—breath held—worlds hinged—on stone-giant’s grasp.
Giant fingertip—calloused stone—brushed obsidian scar-edge—not Geralt.
Giant grunt—approval?—rough finger circled fragment—lifted—gentle—ash-fall soft.
Dagger-sharp—sized giant-thumbnail—it pulsed blue-white—clean light—painting giant-stone purple-grey veins.
Thorin shouted—"Portals collapse!"—pointing—east tunnel—flowstone melted-glob—sealing path.
Borin crawled—ice-sludge—toward Geralt—"Heartstone catalyst… consumed… pool blocked…" Giant—shard-carrier—stood—massive—silver-light held high—beacon—giant-eyes turned—watched—silent decision.
Geralt forced neck—up—tearing psychic ice—voice cracked—"Gate…" Chestplate seized—joints locked—armor conserving energy—forcing stillness.
Giants shifted—rubble-fall—knelt?—forming circle—around silver-shard holder—around Geralt—around smoking scar… toward deeper cavern—obsidian cliffs—molten river-fork—flowing… upward?

Giant knelt—shard-carrier—plunged silver-light—into molten gold-flow—not sink—fusion—purple-white geyser surged—ceilingwards—portal-flare—raw space-time tear—burning ozone-metallic stench—vortex spinning—Martian dust-glint inside?
Giants roared—unified—charging—toward portal-light—toward upward-flow—toward source—not escape… invasion?

Thorin gaped—"They… counterattack…?" Borin whispered—dagger-ash mingling gold-sludge—"Old Ways… remembered…" Geralt struggled—armor yielding—inch—vision blurring—portal-vortex—giant-backs—charging—vanishing—into purple-gold tear—last giant paused—portal-edge—looked back—stone-eyes—met Geralt’s—nodded—deep understanding—shared purpose?—then leaped—consumed light.
Portal pulsed—unstable—shrinking—drill-screech overhead—metal jaws lowering—darkness fell—save vortex-glimmer—escape?
Legion stranded—choice: follow giants… into poisoned stars… or drown below.
Geralt’s palm—Luminare flickered—answering vortex-call… pulling… toward light… toward war.
